title: 49ers’ signing of Brandin Cooks does more than address WR depth

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers’ signing of Brandin Cooks does more than address WR depth
sources.description: Brandin Cooks, 32, gives a major boost to the 49ers' wide receiver position after losses of Ricky Pearsall, De'Zhaun Stribling and Demarcus Robinson.
